# View

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A note that offers a view perspective of related notes as a dashboard, dynamic queries, or embedded bases.

## Scope note

Helps presentation and navigation for a group of notes.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Notes](../ObsidianNotes/)
